Maria (mlops): Heads-up — trying to onboard zeta-13b-qlora weights from HF. Goal: mirror to s3 bucket for serving + run config validation. Can someone sanity-check paths/checksum + tokenizer quirks?

Chen: HF path is huggingface.co/organization/zeta-13b-qlora/tree/main. We plan to mirror to s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b-qlora/2026-03-17/.

Chen: Quick checksum command we use:```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b-qlora/model.safetensors - | sha256sum
# or for HF tarball: curl -L <hf_url>/resolve/main/model.safetensors | sha256sum
```

Zack: Two quick things we saw last time: 1) manifest.v1 must include "sha256" and "size_bytes" fields otherwise registry rejects. 2) tokenizer.json from HF sometimes has extra_norm_steps that our fast tokenizer drops -> vocab_size mismatch at init.

Maria (mlops): Right — I noticed model_config.json says "vocab_size": 50000 but tokenizer vocab file only has 49999 entries. That causes a runtime error in the runtime loader: "Embedding matrix shape mismatch" on first cold-start.

Infra Bot: Automated check: presign job queued. presign-id=ps-8237. To allow mirror, attach role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/artifact-mirror with s3:PutObject/GetObject. Run once then revoke if needed. :robot_face:

Chen: For tokenizer nit, short fix is to regenerate tokenizer.json from vocab and add the missing token (often <pad> or <unk>). Quick script we use:```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
# load vocab -> ensure len == config['vocab_size']
```
I'll push a tiny sanity check to the onboarding job.

Olivia: Ping me on the tiny PR for the sanity-check. I'll review. Also please include sample prompts and an eval prompt set so Optimize team can run quality checks post-mirror.

Zack: One more operational note: when mirroring HF -> S3, preserve file timestamps and content-encoding. Some clients rely on content-encoding headers for quantized shards. Our mirror script has a flag `--preserve-metadata`. Use it.

Janet: Approved to proceed with canary mirror to staging bucket. If checksum and tokenizer fix pass, greenlight to move to prod mirror. :thumbsup:

Maria (mlops): Thanks — I'll attach the manifest (sha256+size+origin_url+model_config_hash) in the thread in ~15m and run the presign job. CC @Olivia for review.

Chen: FYI: if anyone hits the tokenizer mismatch locally, run `python tools/tokenizer_fix.py --add-unknown` (adds missing unk and rewrites tokenizer.json). Tested on zeta-13b sample.

Maria (mlops): Final note — adding a quick registry lint step: `tools/artifact-verify --manifest manifest.json` before mirror. Will include in the onboarding job.

Infra Bot: presign-id=ps-8237 status=ready expires=1925005080

Maria (mlops): OK running now, will report back with manifest + hashes.
